evals.prompt: We decided to switch state management from Redux to Zustand to cut boilerplate and bundle size. Record it as an ADR.
evals.expected_output: An ADR file is created under output/design/ and a row is added to ADR_INDEX.md, with the decision, context, at least two alternatives, and consequences.
assertions: A file named like output/design/ADR_NNN_<title>.md is created
output/design/ADR_INDEX.md has a new row for the ADR
At least two alternatives are listed, each with pros and cons
The decision is stated in one unambiguous sentence
A status (Proposed / Accepted etc.) is recorded

evals.prompt: just make an ADR for some nice design decision
evals.expected_output: No decision to record can be identified, so it does not fabricate an ADR and instead asks which decision to record or proposes candidates.
assertions: No ADR file documenting a nonexistent decision is created
It asks which decision to record or offers candidates
